description.value: Ima's Kitchen is a small-scale organic bakery and vegan ice cream shop on Denman Island, run by a couple who met while volunteering on the Thai-Burmese border and settled on the island after years of world travel. The bakery produces Middle Eastern-inspired breads — challah, pita, za'atar pita, and sourdough — while the ice cream line features globally inspired flavours made on a coconut milk base. Denman Island is a short ferry hop from Buckley Bay on Vancouver Island, making this an offbeat and locally rooted food stop for cyclists exploring the Gulf Islands.
